title: Unity of the Spirit
definition: Unity of the Spirit is the oneness the Holy Spirit creates among believers in Christ and calls them to preserve in love and truth.
summary: The Spirit unites believers into one body under Christ.
christFocus: Jesus prayed for the unity of His people, and the Spirit forms that unity in the Church.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The unity of the Spirit is not produced by human agreement alone. It is created by the Spirit through union with Christ and the shared Gospel.

Believers are called to preserve this unity with humility, patience, love, truth, and peace. Unity does not mean compromise of doctrine or denial of sin.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches often divide over pride, preference, bitterness, or secondary matters. This doctrine matters because the body of Christ should reflect the one Lord it confesses.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Guard unity through humility, forgiveness, truth, and love. Refuse gossip and division, and pursue peace where Scripture allows.
